content.short: UniSat is the leading non-custodial wallet for Bitcoin-native assets including Ordinals, BRC-20, and Runes.
content.description:
UniSat is the definitive self-custodial wallet and inscription service built specifically for the emerging Bitcoin-native ecosystem. As the first open-source wallet to support Ordinals and BRC-20 tokens, the platform provides users with a professional and secure gateway to create, store, and trade digital assets directly on the Bitcoin blockchain. UniSat features a highly accessible interface that supports advanced standards such as Runes and Alkanes, serving as a primary hub for Bitcoin-native innovation.

In addition to its wallet features, UniSat provides a robust marketplace and an integrated inscription tool, allowing participants to interact with Bitcoin's decentralized economy with unparalleled ease. The platform is designed for high reliability and security, featuring deep integration with the Babylon protocol for Bitcoin staking. Through its commitment to open-source development and user-centric design, UniSat has become a cornerstone of the modern Bitcoin landscape, empowering participants to maintain total sovereignty over their digital assets and identity in the evolving Web3 era.
